tasks.title: ATS adapters: Personio XML feed and generic schema.org JobPosting (JSON-LD)

tasks.title: pipeline/jobs/resolve.py: URL-pattern match, verified slug probe, HTML careers fingerprint
tasks.notes: Research: docs/_research/2026-09-21_jobs-collector.md §Resolution steps 1-3 + Risks (slug false positive). Ladder: match_any_url over known URLs (careers hint, seed links) -> probe_slugs over slug_candidates on greenhouse/lever/ashby/rippling/workable/smartrecruiters (max 5 kinds x 3 slugs) and accept a hit only when the board's company name/website matches the company name/domain -> fingerprint_html (homepage, then careers|jobs link; scan hrefs, iframes, script src, redirects for ATS hosts incl. myworkdayjobs.com) -> jsonld board if a JobPosting block exists. Returns ResolveResult(ats_kind, board_id, resolved_by, confidence) or None. LLM step is T-012, wired in T-015.
